quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, Q1 of the company's fiscal 2026, three months ended June 30, 2026): FC-BGA substrates - a new production line launched last fiscal year improved takt time faster than anticipated and the company has already achieved near-full capacity in Q1, which let it secure AI-switch-related business and improved profit margins. Based on customer forecasts received during contract discussions, the schedule for this fiscal year is already fully booked, including the increased capacity from takt-time improvement; a significant portion of capacity is currently occupied by network switches. There will be no capacity expansion this fiscal year. Management believes the FC-BGA profit margin can be maintained and expects levels in Q2 and beyond to remain at the Q1 level.
quarterly_data.figure: FC-BGA near-full capacity in Q1; this fiscal year's schedule fully booked

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the next period in which FC-BGA sales are looked to grow is 2027, when the new production line in Singapore comes online; forecasts for next year's Singapore capacity are expected soon. AI ASIC qualification is proceeding as scheduled - some production begins in Q2 and will gradually increase, but volumes are not expected to reach significant levels this fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: Singapore FC-BGA line online in 2027; AI ASIC production from Q2

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on FC-BGA pricing: in principle the company operates based on market prices; there are discussions, but no further price increases are incorporated into the plan - if accepted they would be an upside. Orders were originally secured at an appropriate price and pricing is discussed within the context of long-term contracts; the company will keep monitoring and negotiate appropriately.

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on advanced semiconductor packaging development expenses: the portion outsourced to universities is funded by a NEDO grant paid directly to the universities, raising operating profit by JPY1.7 billion per year versus budget; the grant-approval notice came later than expected, so equipment installation is delayed by about half a year (work is outsourced so development is not delayed) and depreciation will be JPY1.2 billion lower than planned - a combined annual reduction of JPY2.9 billion, with a JPY1 billion profit increase in Q1. Management confirmed the originally planned YoY increase of JPY7.3 billion in these costs is now JPY4.4 billion. Depreciation starts accruing as scheduled in H2 and will be recognized as planned from the next fiscal year.
quarterly_data.figure: Advanced packaging development cost cut JPY2.9 billion per year (NEDO JPY1.7 billion + depreciation JPY1.2 billion); Q1 profit +JPY1 billion; YoY cost increase JPY4.4 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on the full-year plan, left unrevised: at this point no specific negative factors are anticipated, but as these are only Q1 results the company will carefully assess the situation in the Middle East and developments in the Electronics segment and review closely until the end of Q2 before deciding. Versus the internal plan, Q1 was helped by a JPY2 billion inventory-valuation gain (Living & Industry), JPY1 billion of lower advanced-packaging development expenses, faster FC-BGA takt-time improvement and a temporary displays factor of approximately JPY0.8 billion (a large number of orders at once during structural reforms); management believes results will be largely in line with the plan from Q2 onwards. Foreign exchange added JPY2.6 billion YoY, JPY1.7 billion of it in Electronics.
quarterly_data.figure: Annual plan unrevised; review until end of Q2; FX +JPY2.6 billion YoY (Electronics JPY1.7 billion); displays one-off approximately JPY0.8 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on the Living & Industry segment: Q1 included a JPY2 billion inventory-valuation gain from moving-average raw-material costing after price increases matched to raw-material cost rises (roughly 60 percent domestic, 40 percent overseas), which is temporary and will reverse at some point - possibly not this fiscal year, depending on the Middle East. The acquired Americas packaging business contributed approximately JPY6 billion YoY (about JPY5 billion per quarter last fiscal year), which management believes can continue as the North American market recovers; a further JPY2 billion came from synergies and past investments, mainly overseas, partly possibly demand brought forward. In Europe the changeover to sustainable packaging is proceeding largely as planned, though some major customers indicated they may delay orders slightly due to rising prices. Price increases have been passed on quickly with no negative impact.
quarterly_data.figure: Inventory-valuation gain JPY2 billion; Americas packaging contribution approximately JPY6 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Toppan results briefing Q&A: Q&A for Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results Briefing (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on SG&A: the 0.8-point YoY improvement in the SG&A-to-sales ratio in Q1 reflects workforce-efficiency optimization; alongside corporate reform and business portfolio transformation, the company intends to develop a concrete plan to reduce SG&A expenses by 2 percentage points.
quarterly_data.figure: SG&A ratio improved 0.8 points YoY; target reduction 2 percentage points
